children: US stock indexes ended the week mostly higher as rally in major technology shares offset headwinds from elevated oil prices and rising bond yields.
Robust results across sectors have helped drive equity returns this year.
The FOMC September minutes revealed unanimous support among all 19 policymakers for the recent rate increase, with a majority favouring an additional hike before year-end.

Eurozone retail sales edged up in August, recovering from the previous month’s sharpest decline in over a year, though growth fell slightly short of expectations. Meanwhile, the Eurozone Composite PMI strengthened in September, reaching its highest level in nearly three and a half years, in line with preliminary estimates.

European Central Bank policymakers saw upside inflation risks when they raised rates for the first time since 2023 in September, while emphasizing the need to avoid signalling further moves and keep all options open.
